notes: Students arrive Sunday 2 to 3 p.m. and leave Saturday at 1 p.m.
name: Urban Forestry Careers Camp (UFCC)
org: Maryland Forestry Foundation at the University of Maryland
what_you_do: One week on the UMD campus learning about forestry jobs by doing. You work with people who do these jobs and experts.
who_can_apply: High school students who are sophomores or higher by September 2026, and newly graduated seniors. The page says UFCC 2026 in this section but lists 2027 dates, so confirm the year.
pay_detail: $150 activity fee after acceptance ($153.50 if paid by PayPal). Tuition is covered by a Maryland Department of Natural Resources grant.
duration: One week, arrive Sunday and leave Saturday (July 11 to 17, 2027)
deadline_text: Camp is July 11 to 17, 2027, limited to 30 students. No deadline given; apply as soon as possible.
how_to_apply: Be free all week. Then fill out the online application. Have two adults who are not family send letters of support. They can be a teacher, counselor or club adviser. A committee will let you know. Accepted students pay the fee to hold a spot.
